subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: Should partial Gateway reloads be exposed as one shared degraded/unavailable state that gates `sessions.resolve` and Control UI, or should maintainers limit the fix to narrower restart-recovery notices like the open WebChat PR?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Gateway readiness semantics, session RPC error contracts, Control UI UX, macOS launchd recovery, and persistent restart-recovery behavior; source inspection can show the gap but cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Define Shared Degraded State
options.body: Make reload/readiness a single Gateway contract used by Control UI and session RPCs, then validate it with macOS launchd proof.

options.title: Land Narrow WebChat Notice First
options.body: Accept the open WebChat restart-recovery notice PR as a symptom fix while leaving the broader reload/readiness contract for later.

options.title: Treat As Operator Recovery Only
options.body: Keep the current runtime behavior and document live plugin/config maintenance as an operator hazard, accepting the misleading partial-liveness UX.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Degraded State
recommendation.body: Make reload/readiness a single Gateway contract used by Control UI and session RPCs, then validate it with macOS launchd proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects gateway/session/reload contracts where the history points most strongly to steipete.
